title: Cycle 2.1: The Rendermarch Raid
name: The Rendermarch Raid
intro: Sooner or later, every body in the underhive ends up at the Rendermarch. The dead come in by the cartload, are stacked in the cold vaults and rendered down, and the Corpse Guild pays well for each one. Nobody asks where they came from.

Then word reaches {p:The Carrion Psalm} that the Delaque have been seen in the vaults. The Guild's workers are muttering, and something is stirring among the dead. To the Psalm, the Rendermarch holds the faithful departed, and they will not suffer Delaque hands meddling there. Fresh from their victory at the Banewaters, {@mordecai|Mordecai} gathers his congregation and marches on the vaults before the Theatre can finish whatever they have started.

The Psalm are right. {t:The Midnight Theatre} are in the vaults. {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} has slipped into the Rendermarch with {@wit|Wit}, whose whispers are turning the Guild's workers against their masters, and {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees}, whose presence fills the vaults with a dread nobody can explain. It is quiet work, and it is going well, until the Psalm come out of the gloom. The rest of the Theatre are out in the dark, and they will have to come running.

facts: Paid in Kind: gangs earn 10 credits for each enemy model they take Out of Action
2' × 2' - Deployment kept 6" from the centre rather than 9", and objectives placed 4" in rather than 6"

Free for All: the winner of a roll-off picks a table quarter and their opponent takes the opposite one. Each gang deploys anywhere in its quarter at least 6" from the centre. {p:The Carrion Psalm} win the roll-off and take the containers quarter, so {t:The Midnight Theatre} deploy in the bone yard quarter.

Flank 'Em: the attacker picks a battlefield edge and places an objective at its centre, 6" in from the edge; the defender places one in the same position on the opposite edge. A gang controlling both objectives in the Check for Victory step scores 1 VP, and the first to 3 VP wins. If only one gang still has models on the battlefield, they win; if neither does, it is a draw. Here they sit at the centre of the top and bottom edges, about 4" in, just inside the walls of the manufactorum and the rendering vats.

{p:The Package:} once both crews are deployed, choose a fighter to carry a package marker. From the Check for Victory step of round three onwards, if they are in base contact with a battlefield edge in the enemy deployment zone, they hand it over and the side job is done.

{t:Spread Unrest:} any Active fighter without the Beast subtype may take the Graffiti (Double) action while inside the enemy deployment zone. Once any fighter has done it, the side job is done, even if that fighter later leaves the battlefield.
Surprise Attack: the attacker, {p:The Carrion Psalm}, uses Hybrid (4+4). The defender, {t:The Midnight Theatre}, starts with Custom (3) and brings on Reinforcements (7), D3 each round from the first.

text: {t:The Midnight Theatre} are already at work near the rendering vats. {p:The Carrion Psalm} come in from the north-east, {@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen} leading, and spread out from the north end of the manufactorum towards the containers. When the Psalm appear in force, the workers scatter and flee.
Tucked inside {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor}'s robes are the bones of a martyred saint, and a shrine-keeper hidden beyond the bone yard is waiting to receive them.

ends.alt: Delaque at the rendering vats: Deuteronomy on the broken upper floor, Mistoffelees and Rumpus inside the walls below, and Wit just outside.
ends.caption: The Midnight Theatre spreading dissent.

ends.alt: Cawdor fighters gathered behind ruined walls in front of the containers, with Deus and Amen at the back.
ends.caption: The Carrion Psalm arrive in force.

map.label: Deployment positions for Cycle 2.1: the Carrion Psalm across the containers quarter and the north side of the manufactorum, and Deuteronomy, Mistoffelees, Rumpus and Wit around the rendering vats.

text: {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} draws on the voices of the Psychoteric Choir and reaches into the dark, wrapping himself in a Perfect Void.
He holds the silence in place with a second effort of will.
Cloaked in silence, {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} moves up to a broken window in the rendering vats, where he can watch the Cawdor come.
Across the yard, {@blessed-filth|Blessed Filth} scrambles up the side of the Gothic ruin and onto its roof, looking for a clear line of fire down the street.

He is not alone for long. The rubble at the foot of the wall shifts, and {@rumpus|Rumpus} bursts out of the ground right below him. Behind the walls of the vats, {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} closes his eyes and reaches into the sniper's mind.
The Terrible Truths pour into {@blessed-filth|Blessed Filth}: whispers of what waits for him in the dark, and of what the Delaque already know about him.
The sniper's hands start to shake. He presses himself flat against the roof, sure that something is coming for him. Nobody on the Psalm's side saw how the Delaque did it.

{@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah Emberchoir} rushes forward past the smoke stack, reciting a hymn of Redemption, and {@mordecai|Mordecai}, {@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen} and {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} follow in his wake. {@wit|Wit} stays where he is, crouched on the objective by the vats.

{@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel Crows} and {@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre} push into the street towards the Wyrm, and {@ratsong|Ratsong} scurries forward to hold the objective at the north end of the manufactorum.

ports.alt: Looking out of a window in the rendering vats, past a blurred Deuteronomy, to Elijah, Mordecai and Deus and Amen advancing past the smoke stack and the fuel tank.
ports.caption: Deuteronomy watches the Cawdor come.

ports.alt: Blessed Filth on the roof of the Gothic ruin with his long rifle, Rumpus surfacing in the street below, and Mistoffelees behind the wall of the rendering vats in the foreground.
ports.caption: Blessed Filth on the roof, with Rumpus below and Mistoffelees behind the vats wall.

photo.alt: Elijah Emberchoir, Deus and Amen, Mordecai and Gutter Cantor advancing past the foot of the smoke stack, beside the fuel tank.
photo.caption: The Psalm advance past the smoke stack.

map.label: Positions at the end of round 1: the Carrion Psalm spread from the smoke stack to the gothic ruin, with Ratsong on the north objective and Blessed Filth on the gothic ruin roof; the Midnight Theatre around the rendering vats, with Wit on the south objective, Rumpus in the street below Blessed Filth, and Mungojerrie arriving at the edge of the bone yard.

caption.text: Positions at the end of round 1

blocks.vp: End phase: Ratsong holds the north objective and Wit the south, so neither gang holds both. No VP. One reinforcement joins the Theatre: Mungojerrie brings up the grav gun through the bone yard.

rounds.title: Round 2: The air turns to lead

text: {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel Crows} has seen the Wyrm in the street, and he charges, cleaver raised.
The cleaver comes down hard, and {@rumpus|Rumpus} is left writhing in the dust.
Somehow the Wyrm drags itself away from the Firebrand, leaving a trail across the deck plates.
{@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah Emberchoir} advances into cover by the smoke stack. He has spotted {@mungojerrie|Mungojerrie} coming up through the bone yard, and he opens fire.
The round cracks off the gravestones beside the Ghost and sends him diving for cover.
{@mungojerrie|Mungojerrie} answers with the grav gun. The shot goes wide, but the pulse lands on the wall beside {@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah}, and the air around the Deacon turns to lead.

roll.name: Mungojerrie - Grav Gun
roll.result: Elijah takes 1 wound and is suppressed

rows.result: Miss, scatters onto the wall by Elijah

rows.note: Note: The Graviton Pulse allows no save, and stays in place.

text: {@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah} is crushed against the wall, and the graviton field hangs beside him, warping everything it touches.
The pulse blocks {@mordecai|Mordecai}'s path to the Delaque, so the Word Keeper moves up behind the tank instead and fires at {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy}.
The shot goes wide. In the vats, {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} keeps his concentration and holds the Void in place.
Then he leans out of the window and answers with his flechette pistol.
Needles rattle off the tank around {@mordecai|Mordecai}. His armour turns the one that finds him, but he is forced to duck, and {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} slips back out of sight.
On the roof of the Gothic ruin, {@blessed-filth|Blessed Filth} is still in the grip of the Terrible Truths. He can hear them on the ladder, he is sure of it. They are coming for him.

rows.note: Note: Insanity result "They're Coming for Me".

text: {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} climbs the wall of the vats to get a sight of {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}, and reaches for the Firebrand's mind too.
But {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}'s faith is stronger than the sniper's. He shrugs off the whispers and keeps his eyes on the Delaque.
{@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre} steps out into the street and turns his flamer on {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees}.

roll.name: Vermin Pyre - Flamer
roll.result: Mistoffelees injured and suppressed, Out of Ammo

text: The flames wash over the wall. {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} falls back burnt and smoking, and Vermin's flamer splutters empty.
{@wit|Wit} moves up and fires his stub gun at {@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre}, but the shot goes nowhere.

{@deus-and-amen|Deus} pushes Amen forward, but the Stig-Shambler finds nothing to shoot at. {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} moves up beside his Word Keeper, and {@ratsong|Ratsong} stays crouched on the objective.

ports.alt: Ezekiel Crows and Vermin Pyre advancing beside the Gothic ruin, with Blessed Filth on its roof and a blurred Rumpus in the foreground.
ports.caption: Ezekiel closes on the Wyrm.

photo.alt: The rendering vats from above, with Mistoffelees inside by the red vats, Wit at the wall and Deuteronomy below, while Ezekiel Crows and Elijah Emberchoir close in from the smoke stack side.
photo.caption: The Theatre dug in at the rendering vats.

blocks.vp: End phase: Ratsong still holds the north objective, but no one holds the south. No VP. One reinforcement joins the Theatre: Growltiger. The graviton pulse beside Elijah fades away.

text: With the Cawdor closing fast, the Theatre take the initiative. {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} is too badly burnt to focus on the Psychoteric Choir, so he draws his stub gun and fires at {@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre} instead.
The round forces Vermin into cover, and {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} pulls back behind the wall with {@rumpus|Rumpus}.
{@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel Crows} advances down the street, firing at {@wit|Wit} as he goes.
{@growltiger|Growltiger} has just reached the south edge, and he answers with both pistols at once.
The flechettes go wide, but the autopistol round slams into {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} and knocks him down behind cover. Then {@growltiger|Growltiger}'s autopistol clicks empty.
Still reeling from the graviton hit, {@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah Emberchoir} picks himself up and moves into cover by the Ruin.
In the vats, {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy}'s hold on the Perfect Void slips.
The silence breaks around him, but he moves to the window anyway and fires at {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}.
The needles keep the Firebrand pinned, and {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy}'s pistol is empty.
{@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre} slams a fresh canister into his flamer. In the bone yard, {@mungojerrie|Mungojerrie} works the grav gun's charge back up.
It does him no good. {@deus-and-amen|Amen} charges forward through the gravestones with Deus on the heavy stubbers, and opens fire on {@mungojerrie|Mungojerrie}.

roll.name: Deus and Amen - Twin-linked Heavy Stubber

rows.note: Note: Bulging Biceps to move at Initiative and fire a heavy weapon. Twin-linked to re-roll the Rapid Fire dice.

text: Six rounds find the Ghost, and he goes down among the graves.
{@wit|Wit} fires at {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} and misses.
Then he ducks back into cover. His real mission still lies ahead of him: he is trying to slip past the Psalm and into their ground to spread his unrest.
{@mordecai|Mordecai} and {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} run down the street, chasing the Delaque towards the bone yard.
On the roof, {@blessed-filth|Blessed Filth} tries to hide from the voices.
It doesn't work. Below him, {@ratsong|Ratsong} stays on the objective.

photo.alt: Deus and Amen peering round the Ruin with the heavy stubber, Mordecai and Gutter Cantor in the street, Mungojerrie in the bone yard and a Delaque fighter on the vats' upper floor.
photo.caption: Mordecai and Gutter run down the street, with Deus and Amen behind the Ruin.

map.label: Positions at the end of round 3: the Carrion Psalm pushing down the west street and east past the gothic ruin, with Ratsong on the north objective; the Midnight Theatre around the rendering vats and along the south edge, with Demeter, Rumpleteaser and Jellylorum arriving.

caption.text: Positions at the end of round 3

blocks.vp: End phase: Ratsong holds the north objective and Mistoffelees the south, so neither gang holds both. No VP. Three reinforcements join the Theatre: Demeter, Rumpleteaser and Jellylorum.

text: At the start of the round, the shadows by the north wall shift, and {@macavity|Macavity} steps out of them alongside {@demeter|Demeter}. The Theatre keep priority.
{@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} appears from the gloom with his plasma gun levelled at {@mordecai|Mordecai}.
The bolt sears past the Word Keeper and forces him down, but the coils burn out and the plasma gun goes dark.
{@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel Crows} cracks his stimm-slug. Burning with chemical fury, he charges {@growltiger|Growltiger}.

rows.note:
Note: Bull Charge for +1 Strength and Knockback (6+) on the charge. The stimm-slug gives +2 Movement, +2 Strength and +2 Toughness.
Growltiger suffers a hand injury.

text: The cleaver falls again and again. When {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} steps back, {@growltiger|Growltiger} isn't getting up.
{@wit|Wit} sees the Gunslinger fall and has to hold his nerve.
In the bone yard, {@mungojerrie|Mungojerrie} tries to crawl away from {@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen}, but he can't get up.
{@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre} advances and turns his flamer on {@jellylorum|Jellylorum}.
The flames lick at the Medic and drive him into cover. This time the flamer keeps burning.
In the vats, {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} gathers himself and calls up the Perfect Void again.
This time he holds it.
Then he reloads his flechette pistol.
At the north end of the manufactorum, {@ratsong|Ratsong} looks round and sees shapes moving in every shadow. The little Bonepicker abandons the objective, and {@macavity|Macavity} runs in to take it.
On the roof of the Gothic ruin, {@blessed-filth|Blessed Filth} is still trying to hide.
{@wit|Wit} fires at {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}, then runs.
{@mordecai|Mordecai} fires at {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser}.
The shot goes wide, and the Word Keeper's autopistol runs dry.
{@jellylorum|Jellylorum} shoots back at {@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre}, but his aim is off.
{@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen} crash through the bone yard and turn the heavy stubbers on the fallen {@mungojerrie|Mungojerrie}.

roll.name: Deus and Amen - Twin-linked Heavy Stubber

text: {@mungojerrie|Mungojerrie} lies still among the graves, alive, but only just.
Behind the Psalm's lines, {@demeter|Demeter} daubs the Theatre's mark across the containers. The Guild's workers will see it in the morning, and they will remember who left it.

{@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah Emberchoir} charges forward. {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} stays crouched on the south objective, and {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} slips away towards the edge of the bone yard to deliver the saint's bones.

ports.alt: Ezekiel Crows standing over the fallen Growltiger, autopistol raised, with Growltiger lying on his back beside his two pistols.
ports.caption: Growltiger's last stand.

photo.alt: Macavity crouched behind a ruined wall at the north end of the manufactorum, with Ratsong by the barrels in the foreground.
photo.caption: Macavity closes in on Ratsong at the north objective.

map.label: Positions at the end of round 4: Macavity on the north objective and Mistoffelees on the south; the Carrion Psalm pushed into the bone yard and the Theatre's corner, with Gutter Cantor at the west edge after delivering the package; Growltiger out of action south of the rendering vats.

caption.text: Positions at the end of round 4

blocks.vp: End phase: the Psalm deliver the package, completing their side job. Macavity holds the north objective and Mistoffelees the south, so the Theatre hold both and score 1 VP.

text: With a jolt of adrenaline, {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} rushes in behind {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}, coaxing his plasma gun back to life as he goes, and fires.
The bolt goes wide, and the plasma gun overheats again.
{@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}'s stimm-slug wears off. He shakes his head clear.
Then he turns and charges {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser}.

rows.note: Note: Bull Charge for +1 Strength and Knockback (6+) on the charge.

text: The cleaver bites twice, and the autopistol in his other hand keeps the Ghost pinned. {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} lashes out with his fists.
The blow glances off {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}'s armour.
{@jellylorum|Jellylorum} fires at {@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre}, then moves back towards the objective.
{@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre} steps up and torches {@wit|Wit} and {@jellylorum|Jellylorum} together.

rows.note: Note: Jellylorum suffers a hand injury.

text: {@wit|Wit} dives clear, but the flames catch {@jellylorum|Jellylorum} full on, and the Medic falls burning.
At the north end of the manufactorum, {@macavity|Macavity} charges {@ratsong|Ratsong}.

rows.note: Note: Ratsong suffers an eye injury.

text: The Nacht-Ghul's fangs find the Bonepicker's face, and {@ratsong|Ratsong} goes down.
In the bone yard, {@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen} fall on the helpless {@mungojerrie|Mungojerrie}.

roll.name: Deus and Amen - Coup de Grâce

rows.note: Note: Mungojerrie goes Out of Action with a critical injury.

text: {@deus-and-amen|Amen}'s great club comes down, and {@mungojerrie|Mungojerrie} doesn't move again.
{@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} holds the Perfect Void.
He fires at {@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen}, but the needles go wide.
{@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} fires back at {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy}.
The rounds spark off the window frame. {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy}'s cover holds, but his nerve doesn't, and he drops below the sill.
At the north objective, {@demeter|Demeter} steps out of the shadows and takes it.
{@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah Emberchoir} fires on {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} too.
The round keeps the Master of Shadow pinned, and {@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah}'s autopistol runs dry.
{@rumpus|Rumpus} drags itself across the deck plates and charges {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}, jaws snapping.
{@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}'s armour turns the bite, and he swings back at the Wyrm.
The cleaver misses.
"I'll get you!" On the roof of the Gothic ruin, {@blessed-filth|Blessed Filth} spins round and fires at the nearest figure he can see. It's {@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre}.
The shot goes wide, and the madness doesn't let go.
{@mordecai|Mordecai} charges {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees}.
{@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} fires his stub gun as the Word Keeper closes.
Then the chainglaive comes round.
Its teeth tear through {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees}' coat, and he collapses at {@mordecai|Mordecai}'s feet. Not even Mr. Mistoffelees can conjure his way out of this one.
{@wit|Wit} fires a last shot at {@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre}, then backs away towards the objective.

ports.alt: Macavity looming over Ratsong by the barrels at the north end of the manufactorum, serpent's fangs raised.
ports.caption: Macavity falls on Ratsong.

photo.alt: Mordecai charging Mistoffelees on the wall of the rendering vats, while Rumpleteaser, Rumpus and Ezekiel Crows fight on the other side of the wall.
photo.caption: Mordecai charges Mistoffelees, with Ezekiel locked with Rumpleteaser and Rumpus.

map.label: Positions at the end of round 5: Demeter and Macavity at the north objective, Mordecai engaged with Mistoffelees by the south objective, Ezekiel locked with Rumpleteaser and Rumpus, and Ratsong, Mungojerrie and Jellylorum out of action. Wit has fled.

caption.text: Positions at the end of round 5

blocks.vp: End phase: both gangs take bottle checks. The Psalm hold, but the Theatre fail theirs, and Wit runs from the field.
With their mission complete, the Theatre cut their losses and leave the Rendermarch in the hands of the Cawdor. {p:The Carrion Psalm} win.

prose: The Theatre slip away into the dark with what they came for: the Guild's workers are restless, and the Cawdor will be hearing those whispers for a long time. But the Rendermarch belongs to the Psalm now. {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} recovers from the Word Keeper's chainglaive. The others are not so lucky: {@growltiger|Growltiger} and {@jellylorum|Jellylorum} both carry hand injuries away from the fight, and {@mungojerrie|Mungojerrie} is left critically injured by {@deus-and-amen|Amen}. On the Psalm's side, {@ratsong|Ratsong} loses an eye to {@macavity|Macavity}'s fangs.
